name: Senegal Batis
rangeDescription: Senegambia to southern mauritania, southern niger, and cameroon
description: Typical black, white, and dark-gray batis. Note the chest band, which is black in males and rufous in females.

name: Orange-eyed Thornbird
rangeDescription: Coastal eastern brazil (southern bahia to são paulo)
description: Medium-sized thornbird with a long tail. Note orange eyes and rufous forehead, throat, and tail while the body is largely brown.

name: Common Sandpiper
rangeDescription: Palearctic; winters to southern africa, central asia, philippines, and australia
description: Small bicolored sandpiper which often bobs its tail in a distinctively wagtail-like manner. Plain brown with white underparts; distinguished from bulkier and rounder-headed Green Sandpiper by a prominent white spur at the shoulder.

name: Black Inca
rangeDescription: Montane forest and edge of west slope of eastern andes of colombia and both slopes of serranía de los yariguíes (santander, north-central colombia)
description: Large hummingbird with a long straight bill. Dark blackish-brown overall with a prominent white patch on the side of the neck.

name: Plumbeous Kite
rangeDescription: Eastern mexico to northeastern argentina and all of brazil
description: Slender, long-winged summer migrant to tropical lowlands. Found in humid forest and adjacent semiopen areas with tall trees.

name: Gilt-edged Tanager
rangeDescription: Southeastern brazil (southern bahia and southeastern minas gerais to eastern são paulo)
description: Small and brightly colored tanager found in the canopy and subcanopy of montane forests and second growth. Usually in pairs or small groups and often accompanies mixed-species flocks.

name: Malagasy Pond-Heron
rangeDescription: Madagascar and aldabra; post-breeding dispersal to central africa
description: Chunky, short-legged heron. All white with a black-tipped blue bill and bright red legs in breeding plumage.

name: Black-rumped Waxbill
rangeDescription: Southern mauritania and senegambia eastward to southern sudan, south sudan, eritrea, uganda, and western kenya; also widely introduced, to spain, japan, hawaiian islands, puerto rico, guadeloupe, and martinique (both in central lesser antilles)
description: A tiny finch of dry grasslands, thickets, and grassy woodlands. Similar to Common Waxbill, but note black rump, unbarred back, white (not dark) undertail, and square-tipped tail.

name: Cone-billed Tanager
rangeDescription: Southwestern brazil (goias and mato grosso do sul, rediscovered in 2003)
description: Recently rediscovered tanager. Males are black and white with a whitish-gray bill and small white wing patch.

name: White-headed Petrel
rangeDescription: Islands in southern indian ocean and southern pacific ocean
description: A large gadfly petrel with a pale white head and a distinctive dark eye-patch. Back is pale gray with darker outer wings, creating an “M” shape on the back.

name: Burchell's Sandgrouse
rangeDescription: Southeastern angola to namibia, botswana, and northern cape province
description: A plump, small-headed, pigeon-like bird. Mostly chestnut-cinnamon speckled with white; the male has a gray face and yellow spectacles, and the female has a yellowish face.

name: Japanese Waxwing
rangeDescription: Southeastern siberia and northern manchuria; winters to southern china and ryukyu islands (southern japan)
description: The only waxwing endemic to the old world, this species is similar to its Bohemian relative, but with pink instead of yellow tail tips and a yellow-tinged belly. Irruptive and inconsistent in its movements during the colder months, following crops of berries to wintering grounds, where it frequently gathers in large and noisy feeding flocks.

name: Pale-browed Tinamou
rangeDescription: Tropical forest of western ecuador to northwestern peru
description: Secretive chickenlike bird that walks on the ground inside forest. Very plump; looks tailless.

name: Manchurian Reed Warbler
rangeDescription: Northern manchuria; winters to southern china and thailand
description: Small, shy, and poorly understood, this reed warbler breeds in the remote marshlands of northeastern China and Russia and winters in drier, grassier habitats in Southeast Asia. Warm brown overall with a clean-cut whitish brow and throat; brow extends well behind the eye, unlike in Blunt-winged Warbler.

name: Pileated Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Central mexico (michoacán to oaxaca) and adjacent guatemala
description: Small, rather drab, crested flycatcher of arid scrubby woodland in the interior highlands of southwest Mexico. Mostly retiring and easily overlooked unless singing.

name: Latham's Snipe
rangeDescription: Sakhalin and japan; winters eastern australia including tasmania, and new guinea
description: Long-billed skulking shorebird of muddy edges in freshwater wetlands. Breeds in Japan and spends the nonbreeding season mainly in eastern Australia.

name: Mongolian Lark
rangeDescription: High steppes of mongolia and northern china; winters to central china
description: A large, brightly-colored lark of grassy steppe; often found near lakes and wet meadows. Brown overall with cinnamon tinges to the crown and shoulders, a down-curved white eyebrow, and a blotchy black collar that breaks at the throat.

name: Gray-throated Bulbul
rangeDescription: Southwestern philippines (balabac, busuanga, calamianes, and palawan)
description: A medium-sized bird of lowland and foothill forest and edge on Palawan and neighboring islands. Yellow below with an olive-green back, brown wings and tail, a gray cheek, and a white throat.

name: White-striped Warbler
rangeDescription: Gallery forest of south-central brazil
description: Hyperactive warbler that nervously and continually flicks its tail in the understory of forests near water. Note the broad white eyebrow fringed with gray and the narrow dark mask.
imageCreditName: João Vitor Andriola | Brazil Birding Experts

name: Fischer's Greenbul
rangeDescription: Far southeastern somalia to kenya, tanzania, and northern mozambique
description: Typically dull olive-brown mid-sized greenbul with a long bill, white throat, and reddish tail. Has a whitish eye, and usually shows pale crescents above and below the eye.
